1879064394.name: Ent's Strength (Ranged)
1879064394.desc: This fellowship skill does direct ranged damage to your target and can contribute to fellowship manoeuvres.

1879073610.name: Endurance of Stone
1879073610.desc: For a short amount of time, you can withstand blows that would batter a weaker race's Morale into dust.

1879073738.name: Tainted Kiss
1879073738.desc: A ranged attack which flings a painful contact poison at the target causing damage over time.

1879104842.name: Fungal Bloom
1879104842.desc: Salves of foul herbs and liquids from the depths of Angmar relieve the sting of wounds on the flesh of foul creatures.

1879136970.name: Against The Odds
1879136970.desc: You get a second wind, resetting recovery on many of your skills.

1879138634.name: Blessing of Darkness
1879138634.desc: You focus upon an ally, redirecting damage taken to yourself while your herbs restore your wounds.

1879213898.name: Deep Wounds (Tactical)
1879213898.desc: Your Fellowship strikes at Draigoch's scales, tearing them loose and exposing what lies beneath.

1879242314.name: Bond of the Rider
1879242314.desc: So complete is the Lore-master's understanding and bond with their War-steed that they can influence the morale and state of a war-steed.

1879255498.name: Radiant Burst
1879255498.desc: You hurl a lens toward your target distracting and potentially dismounting them. The glimmering light will attract a murder of crows to hamper the target's movement once the distraction dissipates.\n\n<rgb=#ff6600>This skill cannot be used on a target under the effects of 'Murder of Crows' the movement reducing effect applied by Radiant Burst.</rgb>

1879276106.name: Rejuvenation
1879276106.desc: Your wounds sting less and your pain ebbs as adrenaline flows through your veins.

1879297098.name: Break The Bonds
1879297098.desc: Removes any Crowd Control Effect on the Rune-keeper.

1879302602.name: Call to Arms: Herald of War (Warden)
1879302602.desc: You enlist a Herald to carry your Banner of War into battle. This banner increases the damage dealt by those around it.

1879305546.name: Rain of Arrows: Fire-storm
1879305546.desc: Rains arrows down upon your enemies, allowing you to hit multiple targets.\n\nArrows inflict fire damage.

1879360842.name: Diamondback Snake
1879360842.desc: Brings out a diamondback snake to keep you company.

1879368650.name: Little Kid
1879368650.desc: Brings out a little kid to keep you company.

1879374538.name: Muster in Járnfast
1879374538.desc: Allows the Warden to travel to Járnfast.

1879385802.name: Sienna Goat
1879385802.desc: Brings out a sienna goat to keep you company.

1879406154.name: Steed of Regal Revelry
1879406154.desc: A steed with noble bearing, tempered by many years of service.

1879411786.name: Follow Me!
1879411786.desc: Brawlers have been known to inspire foolhardy acts of bravery in their comrades - mostly by charging headlessly into a fray and dragging their allies along with them against their better judgement.\n\nMove Speed Buff

1879451338.name: Stinging Spores
1879451338.desc: Spores weave their way into your target, attacking their flesh from within.

1879452874.name: Perfect Ballad - Melody
1879452874.desc: Heals you and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879460554.name: Return to Carn Dûm
1879460554.desc: You're able to quickly return to Carn Dûm. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879492170.name: Crushing Shield
1879492170.desc: Your shield is a weapon you wield expertly to create openings in combat, increasing your damage after landing successful blows.\n\nThis skill gives you a greater benefit if it strikes more than one target, achieving maximal potency when it lands against at least 3 targets.

1879507658.name: Oromë's Volley
1879507658.desc: Looses multiple arrows at once, cleansing corruption from several targets in a small area.

1879522634.name: Minor Ballad
1879522634.desc: Boosts Tactical damage and harms your foe.\n\nBallads unlock Anthems and Codas.

1879524042.name: Wrathful Rebuke
1879524042.desc: Release your fury and indignation in a blast, dismaying foes all around you.

1879528266.name: Prepared: Wisp of Frost
1879528266.desc: Gelid Wind adherents deal frost damage swiftly.
